name: Adaptive Agent Attack Replay
mechanism: Generates and manually reviews attacks after inspecting the deployed defense, then repeats them across changed models, tools, message order and multi-turn contexts with fixed state oracles.
use_when: A defense performs strongly on frozen public suites
Attackers can observe policy responses or adapt payloads
avoid_when: Adaptive generation can reach production credentials or effects
expected_effects: Failure discovery under changed attacker strategies
failure_modes: Attack generator optimizes a weak proxy metric
Generated cases leak into final holdouts
